name: Method Man
sources: Sweetwater — the gear behind Wu-Tang Clan's Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers)
notes: RZA's murkiest register. The research states the low end as a production goal in the producer's own words — "really gritty bass" — and everything else in the model gets out of its way: `melody.register` is the lowest on this axis at 55–76, `voicing.register` sits with it, and the bass runs from 22 with `followRootsProb` at 0.96. The kick is on 1 and the 4th 8th, so `secondaryAnchor` is `2&`. The motif is a detuned piano or vocal fragment "sometimes deliberately off-pitch against the bass", which is `timbreHint` `detuned_piano` plus `halfStepDissonance` 0.24. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick`, not a held note, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** The research says sustained on the tonic; `reese_sustain` emits one note per chord and saturates, so `mirror_kick` over a two-hit kick at `followRootsProb` 0.96 is the nearest honest thing. ⚠ **The research says "hats sparse or absent, no fills", and this model can only honour half of that.** `hihat.continuous` is false, but `fillDensity` is held at 0.28 because a model that declares a hat block owes every seed a hat — below that some seeds produce a bar with none. And `fills.smallEveryBars`/`bigEveryBars` are fixed at 2 and 8 by this batch's anti-convergence fingerprint, so the near-absence of fills is carried instead by `snareRoll`: `gapProb` 0.6, `descendProb` 0.06, `rampJitter` 4 and a ramp that tops out at 84 make the fill that does fire quiet and full of holes. Read those three numbers as the record's "no fills", not the fill cadence. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates this high-medium; RZA's gear and philosophy are documented in detail but the tempo band is catalog-level. ⚠ **The bass pool was widened after `bass.rs` measured it at 0.948 distinct against a floor of 0.95.** It was authored with NO passing tones, followRootsProb 0.96, anticipationProb 0.05 over register [22,40] — a faithful description of a sample-loop bass, and one that leaves a seed nothing to vary but root and octave. Now ["P5"], root lock 0.9, anticipation 0.18, register [22,44]. The line is still overwhelmingly root-on-kick; what changed is how many different records it can be, not how busy any one of them is. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 44 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 5. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 955 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
